# Load packages

```{r}
# Note: In case of dependency issues, Run: update.packages(ask = FALSE, checkBuilt = TRUE)
# install.packages('rlang')

#' Ensure specified packages are installed and loaded.
#'
#' Checks if packages are installed, installs missing ones,
#' then attempts to load all specified packages. Uses '=' for assignment.
#'
#' @param pkg_list A character vector of package names.
#' @return Invisibly returns a named logical vector indicating load success for each package.
load_packages = function(pkg_list) {
  
  # Ensure package list is unique
  pkg_list = unique(pkg_list)
  
  # Identify installed packages
  installed_pkgs = rownames(installed.packages())
  
  # Find packages that need installation
  missing_pkgs = pkg_list[!pkg_list %in% installed_pkgs]
  
  # Install missing packages if any exist
  if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
    message("Installing missing packages: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
    tryCatch({
      install.packages(missing_pkgs, dependencies = TRUE)
      # Update the list of known installed packages *after* installation attempt
      installed_pkgs = rownames(installed.packages()) 
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Installation failed for some packages: ", conditionMessage(e))
    })
  }
  
  message("Loading required packages...")
  # Attempt to load all packages in the list
  load_status = sapply(pkg_list, function(pkg) {
    # Check if it's actually installed before trying to load
    if (pkg %in% installed_pkgs) {
      # Use require() as it returns TRUE/FALSE, suitable for sapply
      # suppressPackageStartupMessages keeps the console cleaner
      loaded = suppressPackageStartupMessages(
        require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)
      )
      if (!loaded) {
        warning("Failed to load package: ", pkg)
      }
      return(loaded)
    } else {
      # If it's not in installed_pkgs (even after install attempt)
      warning("Package '", pkg, "' not found or failed to install. Cannot load.")
      return(FALSE)
    }
  })
  
  # Report final status
  if (all(load_status)) {
    message("All required packages loaded successfully.")
  } else {
    failed_pkgs = names(load_status[!load_status])
    warning("Failed to load or install the following packages: ",
            paste(failed_pkgs, collapse = ", "), ".")
  }
  
  # Return the status invisibly (useful for checking programmatically if needed)
  invisible(load_status)
}


# --- Usage ---

# Define the list of required packages
required_packages = c(
  'tidyverse',    # Includes dplyr, ggplot2, purrr, tidyr, etc.
  'haven',        # For reading SPSS, Stata, SAS files
  'qgcomp',       # Quantile G-computation
  'moments',      # Functions to calculate moments
  'naniar',       # Data structures and visualizations for missing data
  'VIM',          # Visualization and Imputation of Missing Values
  'missForest',   # Nonparametric Missing Value Imputation using Random Forest
  'gridExtra',    # Arrange multiple grid-based plots
  'knitr',        # Dynamic report generation
  'infotheo',     # Information-theoretic measures
  'igraph',       # Network analysis tools
  'ggraph',       # Grammar of graph visualization
  'lubridate',    # Working with dates and times
  'zoo',          # S3 Infrastructure for Regular and Irregular Time Series
  'ggridges',     # Ridgeline plots
  'slider',       # Sliding window functions
  'reshape2',     # Flexibly reshape data
  'broom',        # Convert statistical analysis objects into tidy data frames
  'modelsummary', # Summarize models into tables/plots
  'sandwich',     # Robust covariance matrix estimators
  'arrow',        # Interface to Apache Arrow
  'tidymodels',   # Used for train/test split 
  'data.table',   # Enhanced structure for storing data 
  'rsample',      # For split
  'kableExtra',
  'dplyr',
  'RColorBrewer',
  'ggplot2',
  'grid'
)

# Run the function to install (if needed) and load the packages
load_packages(required_packages)
```

# Loop for Modeling



```{r}
# Initialize windows
period_keys <- c("20200315_20200627", "20200322_20200523", "20200412_20200523")
suffixes <-c("_March_15_June_27", "_March_22_May_23", "_April_12_May_23")
stringency_keys <- c("march_15_june_30", "march_22_may_23", "april_12_may_23")

# # For trial check . Uncomment if you want to check
# period_keys <- c("20200315_20200627")
# suffixes <-c("_March_15_June_27")
# stringency_keys <- c("march_15_june_30")
# i = 1

results_est_list <- list()
results_hicc_list <- list()


for (i in seq_along(period_keys)) {
  
  
  # Get train, test and full sample data
  assign("train_data_df", get(paste0("train_data_df", tolower(suffixes[i]))))
  assign("test_data_df", get(paste0("test_data_df", tolower(suffixes[i]))))
  assign("cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency", get(paste0("cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency", tolower(suffixes[i]))))
  

  # Weights
  qgcomp_weights_train = train_data_df$observation_wt_trim 
  qgcomp_weights_test  = test_data_df$observation_wt_trim 
  qgcomp_weights_total_sample = cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency$observation_wt_trim
  
  # All components model to estimate pos and neg components ---------------------------------
  ## get formula
  static_covariates <- c("age_2020",
                         "home",
                         "maritalstatus",
                         "race",
                         "education",
                         "employment",
                         "insurance",
                         "anxiety_disorder_before_covid_lifetime",
                         "anxiety_disorder_1yr_before_covid",
                         "sex",
                         "birthplace",
                         "generalized_anxiety_disorder_before_covid_lifetime",
                         "generalized_anxiety_disorder_1yr_before_covid")
  
  dynamic_covariates <- c(paste0("C1M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C2M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C3M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C4M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C5M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C6M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C7M", suffixes[i]))
  
  exposure_names <- c(paste0("C1M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C2M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C3M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C4M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C5M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C6M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C7M", suffixes[i]))
  
  full_covariates <- c(static_covariates, dynamic_covariates)
  fml <- as.formula(paste("gad_score_july ~", paste(full_covariates, collapse = " + ")))
  
  qgcomp_all_components = qgcomp.glm.noboot(f = fml,
                                          expnms = exposure_names, 
                                          data = test_data_df, 
                                          weights = qgcomp_weights_test,
                                          q = NULL,
                                          bayes = FALSE) 

  print(paste0("All components initial results:- \n"))
  print(qgcomp_all_components)
  
  # Extract components
  ## all components
  all_list <- sub(pattern = paste0(suffixes[i], "$"), 
                  replacement = "", 
                  x = qgcomp_all_components$expnms)
  
  ## pos components
  pos_list <- sub(pattern = paste0(suffixes[i], "$"), 
                  replacement = "", 
                  x = names(qgcomp_all_components$pos.weights))
  
  ## neg components
  neg_list <- sub(pattern = paste0(suffixes[i], "$"), 
                  replacement = "", 
                  x = names(qgcomp_all_components$neg.weights))
  
  ## Print components
  print(cat(" -------------- All Components (", sub("^_", "", suffixes[i]), ") :- --------------------\n", 
            paste(all_list, collapse = ", \n")))
  print(cat(" -------------- Positive Components (", sub("^_", "", suffixes[i]), ") :- --------------------\n", 
            paste(pos_list, collapse = ", \n")))
  print(cat(" -------------- Negative Components (", sub("^_", "", suffixes[i]), ") :- --------------------\n", 
            paste(neg_list, collapse = ", \n")))
  
  ## Final exposure list
  exposure_list <- list(c("C1M"), 
                       c("C2M"),
                       c("C3M"),
                       c("C4M"),
                       c("C5M"),
                       c("C6M"),
                       c("C7M"),
                       all_list,
                       pos_list,
                       neg_list,
                       c("Stringency")
                       )
  
  # Init results df
  result_est_df <- data.frame()
  result_hicc_df <- data.frame()
  
  # Loop over exposures
  
  # # For check
  # exp = neg_list
  
  for(exp in exposure_list){
    
    # Define variables
    static_covariates <- c("age_2020",
                           "home",
                           "maritalstatus",
                           "race",
                           "education",
                           "employment",
                           "insurance",
                           "anxiety_disorder_before_covid_lifetime",
                           "anxiety_disorder_1yr_before_covid",
                           "sex",
                           "birthplace",
                           "generalized_anxiety_disorder_before_covid_lifetime",
                           "generalized_anxiety_disorder_1yr_before_covid")
    
    # Init consolidation setting
    consolidation_set = FALSE
    
    # Get formula
    exp_vals <- if (is.character(exp) && length(exp) == 1 && exists(exp)) get(exp) else exp
    
    if(length(exp_vals) == 1){
      if(!exp_vals %in% c("Stringency")){
        print(paste0("Processing for ", exp_vals))
        
        dynamic_covariates <- c(paste0(exp_vals, suffixes[i]))
        exposure_names <- c(paste0(exp_vals, suffixes[i]))
        full_covariates <- c(static_covariates, dynamic_covariates)
        fml <- as.formula(paste("gad_score_july ~", paste(full_covariates, collapse = " + ")))
      
      } else {
        print(paste0("Processing for ", exp_vals))
      
        dynamic_covariates <- c(paste0("stringency", "_", stringency_keys[i]))
        exposure_names <- c(paste0("stringency", "_", stringency_keys[i]))
        full_covariates <- c(static_covariates, dynamic_covariates)
        fml <- as.formula(paste("gad_score_july ~", paste(full_covariates, collapse = " + ")))
      }
    } else {
      consolidation_set = TRUE
      if (setequal(exp_vals, all_list)) {
        consolidation_name <- "all_components"
      } else if (setequal(exp_vals, pos_list)) {
        consolidation_name <- "pos_components"
      } else if (setequal(exp_vals, neg_list)) {
        consolidation_name <- "neg_components"
      }
      
      print(paste0("Processing for ", consolidation_name))
      dynamic_covariates <- c(paste0(exp_vals, suffixes[i]))
      exposure_names <- c(paste0(exp_vals, suffixes[i]))
      full_covariates <- c(static_covariates, dynamic_covariates)
      fml <- as.formula(paste("gad_score_july ~", paste(full_covariates, collapse = " + ")))
      
    }
    
    # Fit model
    model_qgcomp <- qgcomp.glm.noboot(f = fml,
                                        expnms = exposure_names, 
                                        data = test_data_df, 
                                        weights = qgcomp_weights_test,
                                        q = NULL,
                                        bayes = FALSE) 
    
    # Get HICC estimates
    ## Extract
    hicc_df <- qgcomp.hicc(fit.object =  model_qgcomp$fit,
                           data = test_data_df,
                           cluster_col = "RegionName")
    if(!consolidation_set){
      hicc_df <- cbind(components = sub(pattern = suffixes[i], 
                                replacement = "", 
                                x = exposure_names),
                       hicc_df)
    } else {
      hicc_df <- cbind(components = consolidation_name,
                       hicc_df)
    }
    
    ## Add to df
    result_hicc_df <- rbind(result_hicc_df, hicc_df)
    
    # Get robust estimates
    ## Extract
    robust_df <- qgcomp.robust.est(fit.object = model_qgcomp$fit,
                               cluster_robust = TRUE, 
                               robust_type = "HC1", 
                               cluster_var = test_data_df$RegionName, 
                               exposure_names = exposure_names)
    
    if(!consolidation_set){
      robust_df <- cbind(components = sub(pattern = suffixes[i], 
                                replacement = "", 
                                x = exposure_names), 
                         robust_df)
    } else {
      robust_df <- cbind(components = consolidation_name, 
                         robust_df)
    }
    
    ## Add to df
    result_est_df <- rbind(result_est_df, robust_df)
    
  }
  
  ## Add column for window
  result_est_df <- cbind(exposure_window = sub("^_", "", suffixes[i]),
                         result_est_df)
  result_hicc_df <- cbind(exposure_window = sub("^_", "", suffixes[i]),
                         result_hicc_df)
  
  ## Add to main result list
  results_est_list[[sub("^_", "", suffixes[i])]] <- result_est_df
  results_hicc_list[[sub("^_", "", suffixes[i])]] <- result_hicc_df
  
}

## View results
results_est_list
results_hicc_list
```



```{r}
# Create kable view

## Store all results
all_results <- rbindlist(results_est_list)

## Clean stringency values
all_results$components <- ifelse(grepl("^stringency_", all_results$components),
                     sub("_.*", "_index", all_results$components),
                     all_results$components)

## Add ci column
all_results <- all_results %>%
  mutate(ci = paste0("(", 
                     scales::number(lower_ci, accuracy = 0.001), 
                     ", ", 
                     scales::number(upper_ci, accuracy = 0.001), 
                     ")")
         )

## View
all_results

## Create list of data frames for each window
window_dfs <- lapply(unique(all_results$exposure_window), function(window) {
  all_results %>%
    filter(exposure_window == window) %>%
    select(components, beta, ci, p_val) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(., "_window_", window), -components)
})


## Combine side by side 
final_df <- reduce(window_dfs, left_join, by = c("components"))

## Get p-value columns
pval_cols <- grep("^p_val_", names(final_df), value = TRUE)

## Apply bolding to those columns
final_df_bold <- final_df

for (col in pval_cols) {
  final_df_bold[[col]] <- cell_spec(
    sprintf("%.3f", final_df[[col]]),  # format to 3 decimal places
    format = "html",
    bold = final_df[[col]] < 0.05
  )
}

## Save as kable
result_df_kable <- final_df_bold %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3, 
               booktabs = TRUE, 
               format = "html", 
               escape = FALSE,
               caption = paste0("Quantile gcomp test sample results: direct fit")) %>%
  kable_styling(font_size = 15, fixed_thead = TRUE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

print(result_df_kable)
```

```{r}
      if (setequal(exp_vals, all_list)) {
        consolidation_name <- "all_components"
      } else if (setequal(exp_vals, pos_list)) {
        consolidation_name <- "pos_components"
      } else if (setequal(exp_vals, neg_list)) {
        consolidation_name <- "neg_components"
      }
      
      print(paste0("Processing for ", consolidation_name))
      dynamic_covariates <- c(paste0(exp_vals, suffixes[i]))
      exposure_names <- c(paste0(exp_vals, suffixes[i]))
      full_covariates <- c(static_covariates, dynamic_covariates)
      fml <- as.formula(paste("gad_score_july ~", paste(full_covariates, collapse = " + ")))
      
    }
    
    # Fit model
    model_qgcomp <- qgcomp.glm.noboot(f = fml,
                                        expnms = exposure_names, 
                                        data = test_data_df, 
                                        weights = qgcomp_weights_test,
                                        q = NULL,
                                        bayes = FALSE) 
    
    
    # Get robust estimates
    ## Extract
    robust_df <- qgcomp.robust.est(fit.object = model_qgcomp$fit,
                               cluster_robust = TRUE, 
                               robust_type = "HC1", 
                               cluster_var = test_data_df$RegionName, 
                               exposure_names = exposure_names,
                               disaggregated = TRUE)
    
    ## Clean up the term column
    robust_df$term <- ifelse(
      robust_df$term == "mixture",
      "Overall mixture effect (psi1)",
      gsub(pattern = suffixes[i], replacement = "", x = robust_df$term)
    )
    
    ## Get plot df
    plot_df <- robust_df %>%
      mutate(
        type = ifelse(term == "Overall mixture effect (psi1)", "Overall Effect", "Individual Weight"),
        estimate = beta,
        ci_lower = lower_ci,
        ci_upper = upper_ci
      )
    
    ## Map
    plot_df$term <- ifelse(
      plot_df$term %in% names(component_label_map),
      component_label_map[plot_df$term],
      plot_df$term  # leave as-is for "Overall mixture effect (psi1)" etc.
    )
    
    ## Order terms
    ordered_terms <- c(
      "Overall mixture effect (psi1)",
      plot_df %>% filter(type == "Individual Weight") %>% arrange(desc(estimate)) %>% pull(term)
    )
    plot_df$term <- factor(plot_df$term, levels = rev(ordered_terms))
    
    plot_df
    
    # Define colors
    low_color <- brewer.pal(n = 9, name = "RdBu")[9] # Blue
    high_color <- brewer.pal(n = 9, name = "RdBu")[1] # Red
    mid_color <- "white"
    window_title <- suffix_to_window_title[[suffixes[i]]]
    x_axis_limits <- c(-0.15, 0.15)
    base_font_size <- 12
    
    # Plot
    p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
      
      geom_errorbarh(data = filter(plot_df, type == "Overall Effect"),
                     aes(xmin = ci_lower, xmax = ci_upper),
                     color = "black", height = 0.18, linewidth = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
      
      geom_point(data = filter(plot_df, type == "Overall Effect"),
                 shape = 22, fill = "black", color = "black", size = 3.0, stroke = 0.5) +
      
      geom_point(data = filter(plot_df, type == "Individual Weight"),
                 aes(fill = estimate),
                 shape = 21, color = "black", size = 2.75, stroke = 0.7) +
      
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = low_color, mid = mid_color, high = high_color,
                           midpoint = 0, name = "Mixture\nWeight",
                           guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
                                                  barwidth = unit(0.75, "cm"), barheight = unit(4, "cm"))) +
      
      labs(title = window_title, x = "Effect Estimate", y = NULL) +
      #coord_cartesian(xlim = x_axis_limits, clip = "off") +
      theme_bw(base_size = base_font_size) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = rel(1.1), margin = margin(b = 15)),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(size = rel(0.85), face="plain", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.text = element_text(size = rel(0.75)),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill="transparent"),
        legend.box.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey70"),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0, size=rel(0.95)),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face = "plain", size = rel(1), margin = margin(t = 10)),
        axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "grey40"),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey40"),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
      )
    
    plot_list[[paste0(consolidation_name, suffixes[i])]] <- p
    
  }
  
}
```

# Loop for Age Stratified Modeling


```{r}
# Initialize windows
period_keys <- c("20200315_20200627", "20200322_20200523", "20200412_20200523")
suffixes <-c("_March_15_June_27", "_March_22_May_23", "_April_12_May_23")
stringency_keys <- c("march_15_june_30", "march_22_may_23", "april_12_may_23")

# # For trial check . Uncomment if you want to check
# period_keys <- c("20200315_20200627")
# suffixes <-c("_March_15_June_27")
# stringency_keys <- c("march_15_june_30")
# i = 1

results_est_list <- list()
results_hicc_list <- list()


for (i in seq_along(period_keys)) {
  
  
  # Get train, test and full sample data
  assign("train_data_df", get(paste0("train_data_df", tolower(suffixes[i]))))
  assign("test_data_df", get(paste0("test_data_df", tolower(suffixes[i]))))
  assign("cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency", get(paste0("cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency", tolower(suffixes[i]))))
  

  # Weights
  qgcomp_weights_train = train_data_df$observation_wt_trim 
  qgcomp_weights_test  = test_data_df$observation_wt_trim 
  qgcomp_weights_total_sample = cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency$observation_wt_trim
  
  # Init age list
  results_est_age_list <- list()
  results_hicc_age_list <- list()
  
  for (group in levels(test_data_df$age_group)){
    print(paste0("Processing for age group: ", group))
    
    # Get analysis data
    analysis_data = test_data_df %>% filter(age_group == group)
    qgcomp_weights_analysis = analysis_data$observation_wt_trim
    
    # All components model to estimate pos and neg components ---------------------------------
    ## get formula
    static_covariates <- c("age_2020",
                           "home",
                           "maritalstatus",
                           "race",
                           "education",
                           "employment",
                           "insurance",
                           "anxiety_disorder_before_covid_lifetime",
                           "anxiety_disorder_1yr_before_covid",
                           "sex",
                           "birthplace",
                           "generalized_anxiety_disorder_before_covid_lifetime",
                           "generalized_anxiety_disorder_1yr_before_covid")
    
    dynamic_covariates <- c(paste0("C1M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C2M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C3M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C4M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C5M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C6M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C7M", suffixes[i]))
  
    exposure_names <- c(paste0("C1M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C2M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C3M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C4M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C5M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C6M", suffixes[i]),
    paste0("C7M", suffixes[i]))
    
    full_covariates <- c(static_covariates, dynamic_covariates)
    fml <- as.formula(paste("gad_score_july ~", paste(full_covariates, collapse = " + ")))
    
    qgcomp_all_components = qgcomp.glm.noboot(f = fml,
                                            expnms = exposure_names,
                                            data = analysis_data,
                                            weights = qgcomp_weights_analysis,
                                            q = NULL,
                                            bayes = FALSE)
  
    print(paste0("All components initial results:- \n"))
    print(qgcomp_all_components)
    
    # Extract components
    ## all components
    all_list <- sub(pattern = paste0(suffixes[i], "$"), 
                    replacement = "", 
                    x = qgcomp_all_components$expnms)
    
    ## pos components
    pos_list <- sub(pattern = paste0(suffixes[i], "$"), 
                    replacement = "", 
                    x = names(qgcomp_all_components$pos.weights))
    
    ## neg components
    neg_list <- sub(pattern = paste0(suffixes[i], "$"), 
                    replacement = "", 
                    x = names(qgcomp_all_components$neg.weights))
    
    ## Print components
    print(cat(" -------------- All Components (", sub("^_", "", suffixes[i]), ") :- --------------------\n", 
              paste(all_list, collapse = ", \n")))
    print(cat(" -------------- Positive Components (", sub("^_", "", suffixes[i]), ") :- --------------------\n", 
              paste(pos_list, collapse = ", \n")))
    print(cat(" -------------- Negative Components (", sub("^_", "", suffixes[i]), ") :- --------------------\n", 
              paste(neg_list, collapse = ", \n")))
    
    ## Final exposure list
    exposure_list <- list(c("C1M"), 
                       c("C2M"),
                       c("C3M"),
                       c("C4M"),
                       c("C5M"),
                       c("C6M"),
                       c("C7M"),
                       all_list,
                       pos_list,
                       neg_list,
                       c("Stringency")
                       )
    
    # Init results df
    result_est_age_df <- data.frame()
    result_hicc_age_df <- data.frame()
    
    for(exp in exposure_list){
    
      # Define variables
      static_covariates <- c("age_2020",
                             "home",
                             "maritalstatus",
                             "race",
                             "education",
                             "employment",
                             "insurance",
                             "anxiety_disorder_before_covid_lifetime",
                             "anxiety_disorder_1yr_before_covid",
                             "sex",
                             "birthplace",
                             "generalized_anxiety_disorder_before_covid_lifetime",
                             "generalized_anxiety_disorder_1yr_before_covid")
      
      # Init consolidation setting
      consolidation_set = FALSE
      
      # Get formula
      exp_vals <- if (is.character(exp) && length(exp) == 1 && exists(exp)) get(exp) else exp
      
      if(length(exp_vals) == 1){
        if(!exp_vals %in% c("Stringency")){
          print(paste0("Processing for ", exp_vals))
          
          dynamic_covariates <- c(paste0(exp_vals, suffixes[i]))
          exposure_names <- c(paste0(exp_vals, suffixes[i]))
          full_covariates <- c(static_covariates, dynamic_covariates)
          fml <- as.formula(paste("gad_score_july ~", paste(full_covariates, collapse = " + ")))
        
        } else {
          print(paste0("Processing for ", exp_vals))
        
          dynamic_covariates <- c(paste0("stringency", "_", stringency_keys[i]))
          exposure_names <- c(paste0("stringency", "_", stringency_keys[i]))
          full_covariates <- c(static_covariates, dynamic_covariates)
          fml <- as.formula(paste("gad_score_july ~", paste(full_covariates, collapse = " + ")))
        }
      } else {
        consolidation_set = TRUE
        if (setequal(exp_vals, all_list)) {
          consolidation_name <- "all_components"
        } else if (setequal(exp_vals, pos_list)) {
          consolidation_name <- "pos_components"
        } else if (setequal(exp_vals, neg_list)) {
          consolidation_name <- "neg_components"
        }
        
        print(paste0("Processing for ", consolidation_name))
        dynamic_covariates <- c(paste0(exp_vals, suffixes[i]))
        exposure_names <- c(paste0(exp_vals, suffixes[i]))
        full_covariates <- c(static_covariates, dynamic_covariates)
        fml <- as.formula(paste("gad_score_july ~", paste(full_covariates, collapse = " + ")))
        
      }
      
      # Fit model
      model_qgcomp <- qgcomp.glm.noboot(f = fml,
                                          expnms = exposure_names, 
                                          data = analysis_data, 
                                          weights = qgcomp_weights_analysis,
                                          q = NULL,
                                          bayes = FALSE) 
      
      # Get HICC estimates
      ## Extract
      hicc_df <- qgcomp.hicc(fit.object =  model_qgcomp$fit,
                             data = analysis_data,
                             cluster_col = "RegionName")
      if(!consolidation_set){
        hicc_df <- cbind(components = sub(pattern = suffixes[i], 
                                  replacement = "", 
                                  x = exposure_names),
                         hicc_df)
      } else {
        hicc_df <- cbind(components = consolidation_name,
                         hicc_df)
      }
      
      ## Add to df
      result_hicc_age_df <- rbind(result_hicc_age_df, hicc_df)
      
      # Get robust estimates
      ## Extract
      robust_df <- qgcomp.robust.est(fit.object = model_qgcomp$fit,
                                 cluster_robust = TRUE, 
                                 robust_type = "HC1", 
                                 cluster_var = analysis_data$RegionName, 
                                 exposure_names = exposure_names)
      
      if(!consolidation_set){
        robust_df <- cbind(components = sub(pattern = suffixes[i], 
                                  replacement = "", 
                                  x = exposure_names), 
                           robust_df)
      } else {
        robust_df <- cbind(components = consolidation_name, 
                           robust_df)
      }
      
      ## Add to df
      result_est_age_df <- rbind(result_est_age_df, robust_df)
      
  }
  
  ## Add column for window
  result_est_age_df <- cbind(age_group = group,
                         result_est_age_df)
  result_hicc_age_df <- cbind(age_group = group,
                         result_hicc_age_df)
  
  ## Add to age result list
  results_est_age_list[[group]] <- result_est_age_df
  results_hicc_age_list[[group]] <- result_hicc_age_df
    
  }
  
  # Consolidate age dfs
  ## Curate df for hicc
  all_age_hicc <- rbindlist(results_hicc_age_list)
  all_age_hicc <- cbind(exposure_window = sub("^_", "", suffixes[i]),
                         all_age_hicc)
  
  ## Curate df for est
  all_age_results <- rbindlist(results_est_age_list)
  
  
  ### Clean stringency values
  all_age_results$components <- ifelse(grepl("^stringency_", all_age_results$components),
                       sub("_.*", "_index", all_age_results$components),
                       all_age_results$components)
  
  ### Add ci column
  all_age_results <- all_age_results %>%
    mutate(ci = paste0("(", 
                       scales::number(lower_ci, accuracy = 0.001), 
                       ", ", 
                       scales::number(upper_ci, accuracy = 0.001), 
                       ")")
           )
  
  ### Create list of data frames for each window
  age_dfs <- lapply(unique(all_age_results$age_group), function(group) {
    all_age_results %>%
      filter(age_group == group) %>%
      select(components, beta, ci, p_val) %>%
      rename_with(~ paste0(., "_age_", group), -components)
  })



  ### Combine side by side 
  final_age_df <- reduce(age_dfs, left_join, by = c("components"))
  colnames(final_age_df) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(final_age_df))
  
  ## Add to main result list
  results_est_list[[sub("^_", "", suffixes[i])]] <- final_age_df
  results_hicc_list[[sub("^_", "", suffixes[i])]] <- all_age_hicc
    
}

results_est_list <- imap(results_est_list, function(df, name) {
  cols_to_rename <- setdiff(names(df), "components")
  names(df)[names(df) %in% cols_to_rename] <- paste0(cols_to_rename, "_", name)
  df
})
```
